context: Kenji and Yuki set up a disaster alert app.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech help; vocabulary (地震/出来事/発信/引き続き/方面) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: このアプリ、地震の通知が来るの?
lines.en: Does this app send earthquake alerts?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、すぐに発信されますよ。
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: どの方面の情報も、来ますか?
lines.en: Does it bring info for every area?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 住んでいる方面を、登録できます。
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 大きな出来事も、知らせてくれる?
lines.en: Will it notify me of major events too?
lines.style: engaged office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、出来事を引き続き発信します。
lines.style: reassuring office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 引き続き、更新されるんですね。
lines.style: understanding office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 地震の時、きっと役立ちますよ。
lines.en: It'll surely help during an earthquake.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
